title: Quality problems
text:
Quality problems. Unfortunately two of the peg/wood screw pairs would not faster tightly. Fortunately I can get by without them, but had I purchased this expecting to populate all of the pegs I would have been disappointed.

On the plus side the wood is otherwise sturdy and it is very easy to assemble. No instructions were provided (nor were they needed), and the only tool required was included in the package.

product_metadata.title: PARANTA Metal Boot Storage Rack, Stand-alone Storage Rack, Hold 6 Pairs of Boots, Black
features: Durable Material: Made of high-quality iron, strong and durable, and can store your boots perfectly

Simple Design: Independent and upright stand, accommodate 6 pairs of boots, including 3 pairs of short boots and 3 pairs of boots. The rounded and smooth top design protects the boots from scratches and damage
Easy to assemble: Easy to install, only need to fix the support rod on the bottom platform to use
Space-saving: Compact design does not take up much space, making your home tidy and clean, and you can quickly find the shoes you need
